title: Leak Sensor Correlation with Cabinet Humidity
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=leaksensor:event
| stats count as leak_events avg(cabinet_humidity_pct) as avg_cabinet_humidity_pct by cabinet
| sort - leak_events
description: Compares leak events with average cabinet humidity to show where slow salt creep or condensation may be building trouble.
value: Cabinet humidity often rises before a dramatic leak, making it a useful companion metric for tank-stand risk.
implementation: Log each leak-sensor event and pair it with nearby humidity readings inside the cabinet or stand.
visualization: Bar chart of leak events and cabinet humidity by location.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which tank cabinets are damp and seeing leak warnings more often than the others.
